success_criterion: signal replicated if post-treatment-state -> resistance holds SAME DIRECTION with frozen pipeline in >=2 independent cohorts beyond BriTROC-1, with effect sizes+CIs; non-replication reported honestly.
success_criterion_evaluation: NOT MET. Requires >=2 independent cohorts BEYOND BriTROC-1 showing the predicted direction (higher post-treatment pathway score -> resistant, AUROC>0.5) with effect sizes+CIs. Result: 0 such cohorts. BriTROC-1 is the sole positive external cohort (s7 relapse AUROC 0.874, p=0.035) but rests on only 3 resistant patients (EPV=3). The independent expression cohort GSE160626 points in the OPPOSITE direction (all pathways higher in sensitive; PI3K nominally significant opposite, p=0.043). The discovery cohort's published headline statistics do not reproduce.

descriptive_meta_DDR_AUROC.WARNING: I^2=83% (Q p=0.0025): extreme between-cohort heterogeneity. Pooled value is an artifact of BriTROC-1's dominant weight (a CN signature, not an expression score) and MUST NOT be reported as a pooled result. Report per-cohort only.

bottom_line: The expansion does NOT broadly strengthen the resistance-PREDICTION claim; it defines the evidentiary boundary. Positive serial signal: BriTROC-1 only (fragile, EPV=3). Independent expression replication: FAILS (GSE160626 opposite direction). Discovery headline stats: NOT reproduced (only delta-null reproduces). Pathway dynamics (GSE109934): DDR is significantly modulated by chemo (mechanism plausibility) but unlabeled. Prognostic context (TCGA-OV): only PI3K associates with OS (HR=1.30, p=0.023), a different pathway emphasis and a different (prognostic, not serial) claim. Tiering remains RUO / hypothesis-generating.
